description: Pro. Check the links on a site. Crawls the site from `url` (same origin only, up to 40 pages, 4 requests at a time, or only the `paths` you list), uses sitemap.xml to find pages, and obeys robots.txt for the user agent ATPDesigners. Reads static HTML only. The result opens with coverage: pages read of pages found, which were skipped or truncated, and requests used. Collects internal links from the pages read, requests up to 60 destinations not already crawled (HEAD first, GET if HEAD fails), and reports non-2xx results, redirects (final URL only; hop counts are not visible), links to http, links with no name, vague link text, one text pointing to different places, and links with no destination. Links with aria-hidden=true are not counted as unnamed. Optional `maxLinkChecks` lowers the check cap.

maxLinkChecks.description: Optional lower cap on extra link requests. The hard cap is 60.

maxPages.description: Optional lower page cap. The hard cap is 40 pages.

paths.description: Optional list of same-origin paths such as /about. When given, only these pages are read and links are not followed.

sitemap.description: Use sitemap.xml to find pages. Default true.

url.description: Home page or any page on the site. The crawl stays on this origin.

name: site_link_health
title: Site link health
